meta.title: A buyer cannot read another buyer's draft
gaps: the case needs a caller who is not a super admin (or lacks a permission), and every run acts as the client's own super-admin buyer — a refusal it expects may legitimately not happen
it does not read the record back to confirm what was kept or shown

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with one line item and an RFQ (pricing) round attached, not published.
steps: The buyer sends the request that reads the event, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You are not authorized to perform this action”, and never with a server error.
